title: pyrrocoma howellii
intro: Pyrrocoma howellii, commonly known as Howell's goldweed, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and infections. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrocoma howellii include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
